All Comments: alex.meier@intcom.com: Colleague from Luxembourg reports that the issue started spreading around 15:00.

records.Summary: Investigation Needed: Possible Issue with NAV Calculation - Stale Price Feed
records.Description: On 2023-10-15, we noticed discrepancies in the Net Asset Value (NAV) calculation for the Luxembourg-based 'Funds Europe' fund, specifically in the valuation of the German market portfolio. The system reported that prices for several securities were missing or stale, leading to potential inaccuracies in the fund's daily NAV. Initial checks revealed that the vendor price feed from 'PriceFeedService' had not updated for the past 48 hours. We have manually entered the latest prices, but the issue persists for some securities. We are currently investigating why the price feed is not updating as expected. We are considering changing the price feed source as a potential workaround, but need further investigation to ensure this is the best course of action.
All Comments: eva.keller@intcom.com: CC: @colleague1 - Please review the manual price entry for any discrepancies and provide insights.
jonas.berg@intcom.com: CC: @colleague2 - We need your assistance in verifying the vendor's system status.

records.Summary: Price feed service downtime affects fund valuation
records.Description: Since 14:00 CET today, the vendor price feed service has been unavailable, causing stale prices to be used in the fund valuation process. The system reported an error: 'Connection refused to server [99.194.12.214]'. We have tried restarting the service and checking network connectivity, but the issue persists. Over 10 funds are currently impacted, leading to delays in valuation reports. We have a workaround to use historical data, but it's cumbersome and may introduce errors.
All Comments: sofia.lind@intcom.com: Colleague in Luxembourg reported similar issues with the same vendor service down in their region.
eva.keller@intcom.com: Monitoring the vendor's status page indicates they are aware of the issue and are working on a fix, but no ETA is available.

records.Summary: Investigation Required: Fund Pricing - Multiple Tolerance Breaches
records.Description: Investigated multiple NAV tolerance breaches for the Luxembourg fund F12345 on 10/15/2023. The final NAV was significantly lower than the estimated NAV, with discrepancies of up to 1.5%. This has caused delays in fee accruals and NAV sign-off. The issue is intermittent, with no clear pattern. Attempted to rerun the NAV strike but received an error message: 'Data validation failed - unexpected null value'. Colleague Sarah mentioned similar issues last week, suggesting a potential configuration error. Assessment: Urgency - High, Impact - Medium.
All Comments: sofia.lind@intcom.com: Colleague Sarah: 'We've seen this before, might be related to the recent update in the pricing engine.'
eva.keller@intcom.com: Colleague Mark: 'Check the log files for any recent changes or errors around the same time as the breaches.'

records.Summary: NAV calculation for Fund X, Share Class Y shows multiple NAV tolerance breaches in the last 24 hours, affecting 125,000,
records.Description: The NAV calculation for Fund X, Share Class Y showed multiple breaches of the tolerance levels in the last 24 hours. The latest calculated NAV is 125,000, which is significantly different from the estimated NAV. The error message indicates 'ToleranceExceededError: NAV calculation outside tolerance limits.' We have already checked the data sources and re-run the calculations, but the issue persists. The NAV sign-off and publication are delayed, impacting our clients and financial counterparties.
All Comments: marc.dupont@intcom.com: Colleague in Luxembourg: Same issue reported for Fund Z, Share Class Z. Check if there's a common pattern.

records.Summary: Investment Book of Record - Trade Matching Error
records.Description: Investors in the Luxembourg office have reported discrepancies in their trade bookings in the Investment Book of Record system. The error appears during the daily close process, specifically when matching trades against the fund positions. The error message states, 'Trade ID 123456789 does not match any existing trade in the system.' We have double-checked the trade details and confirmed that the trades exist in the trade capture system. Additionally, we tried running a manual reconciliation using the system's built-in tools but encountered the same issue. This has caused delays in the closing of the books for today, impacting multiple funds. The error seems to be occurring consistently for a particular fund, Fund X. The total value of the affected trades is approximately 150,000 EUR. The error persists even after multiple restarts of the system and re-running the daily processes.
All Comments: sofia.lind@intcom.com: Colleague in Germany: We're seeing similar issues with our European funds. They suggest it might be related to the reconciliation process timing out.

records.Summary: Investment book of record - Error in transaction bookings
records.Description: On 2023-09-15 at 14:00, an error occurred in the Investment Book of Record system while processing transaction bookings for the 'Blue Fund'. The system displayed the error message 'Insufficient funds for transaction [TXN12345]'. The transaction was for a purchase of 1,000 shares in company XYZ at €150 per share. The system failed to complete the booking, causing a hold on the transaction. We've tried running the booking again, but the error persists. The Blue Fund is scheduled for an accounting close at 16:00 today. The fund manager is concerned about the impact on the reconciliation process.
All Comments: eva.keller@intcom.com: It seems that the system might be overdrawn due to recent transactions. We should check the fund's cash position.
sofia.lind@intcom.com: The fund manager needs a workaround to prevent a delay in the accounting close process.

records.Summary: Issue with Regulatory Reporting System - License Expiry
records.Description: Received an email notification from the Regulatory Reporting System stating that the license for the Compliance Check Module is about to expire on 15th of March. The system is currently reporting 100% compliance, but we are unsure if this is accurate due to the pending license issue. The error message received is 'License Expired, Compliance Check Unavailable.' We have tried extending the license through the usual renewal process, but the system is still reporting issues. This is critical as it affects our ability to conduct pre- and post-trade compliance checks and risk model runs. The system is currently in use by all business entities in Europe, impacting up to 100 users.
All Comments: jonas.berg@intcom.com: It's important to ensure that we have a clear understanding of the compliance status before the license expires. Can we get a clarification on the status from the vendor?
eva.keller@intcom.com: We need to prepare a fallback plan in case the issue persists until the 15th of March.

records.Summary: Investigation required for delayed risk model runs
records.Description: We are experiencing delays in risk model runs which are critical for generating exposure alerts. The latest run for the 'Euro Zone Fixed Income' fund started at 14:00 on 2023-10-15 but has not completed as of 16:00. The system is displaying an error message: 'Timeout during data processing'. We have already checked the database connection and it appears to be stable. The issue seems to be related to the large volume of data being processed. Please investigate and resolve as soon as possible to prevent delays in our compliance checks and investment limit breaches.
All Comments: jonas.berg@intcom.com: Is there a way to prioritize the current run to ensure it completes in a timely manner?
marc.dupont@intcom.com: Can we rerun the latest incomplete batch to ensure we have up-to-date exposure alerts?

records.Summary: Error in SharePoint & File Storage Affecting Rimes Deliveries
records.Description: We have noticed that some Rimes benchmark, index, and reference-data deliveries are late or missing. For instance, today's delivery for the 'Europe 500' index constituent weights are not available. Error message: 'Failed to retrieve file from SharePoint: 404 Not Found.' We have already checked our local file storage and it is not present there either. Tried restarting the server and accessing the SharePoint site manually, but the issue persists. This is impacting the daily reporting process for the Luxembourg office.
All Comments: marc.dupont@intcom.com: Colleague from Luxembourg: Confirming that the issue has affected the daily reporting process and is impacting the European clients as well.
alex.meier@intcom.com: IT Support: Investigating the root cause of the missing files and the error message.

records.Summary: Late Rimes Benchmark File Delivery for European Funds
records.Description: The Rimes benchmark system failed to deliver the scheduled benchmark file for the 'Luxury Goods Fund' on 2023-10-15. The file is crucial for the end-of-month report and is expected to be delivered by 16:00 CET today. The latest log shows an error message: 'Error in file transfer: timeout expired'. The fund manager reported that without this file, they cannot proceed with the report preparation and submission by the deadline. Steps taken: Restarted the Rimes service and manually triggered the file transfer, but the issue persists. The fund manager is concerned about missing data and potential delays.
All Comments: jonas.berg@intcom.com: From IT: Investigating the root cause of the timeout issue, suspecting network latency issues.
jonas.berg@intcom.com: From Compliance: Urgent, need to ensure no regulatory data gaps.

records.Summary: Client Reporting System Shows Incorrect License Expiry Dates
records.Description: We've noticed that the Client Reporting System is displaying incorrect license expiry dates for several funds. For instance, for the Luxembourg fund 'LuxEquities Fund', the system shows the license expires on 2023-11-15, but the correct date is 2023-12-15. This discrepancy might affect our compliance reporting. Steps already taken: Checked the fund's record in the Licensing System, which shows the correct dates. No errors or logs have been found so far. Tried clearing cache and restarting the browser, but the issue persists. Expected resolution: Correct the date in the Client Reporting System.
All Comments: sofia.lind@intcom.com: Sara from Legal: Confirming that this incorrect expiry date does not affect our legal obligations as of now, but we need to ensure it's fixed before the next reporting period.

records.Summary: Client unable to access portfolio review due to missing license
records.Description: A client reported that they are unable to access their portfolio review on the self-service portal. The error message states: 'License not found for user.' The client is trying to access their account from the Switzerland office. They have already checked their user profile and confirmed that they are assigned the correct role. This issue affects their ability to review their investment portfolio, which is critical for upcoming meetings with clients. The last successful login was at 14:00 yesterday.
All Comments: marc.dupont@intcom.com: Colleague in HR confirmed that the client's license was correctly assigned but the system may still need a cache update.

records.Summary: Outlook sync issues causing email delays - users report 30+ min delay in receiving emails
records.Description: Users in Switzerland and France are experiencing a significant delay in receiving emails via Outlook. The delay is estimated to be 30+ minutes. Users report seeing a message: 'Account not available. Please try again later'. We've already checked the Office 365 status page, and it shows no active incidents. We've also verified network connectivity and user credentials. The issue seems to be with the identity platform as users with the same credentials on mobile devices are receiving emails as expected. We're concerned this might be an authentication issue since it's affecting SSO and MFA users specifically.
All Comments: eva.keller@intcom.com: Has anyone seen similar issues with other SaaS applications? Could it be a broader platform issue?
alex.meier@intcom.com: Should we reach out to the identity platform support team for assistance?

records.Summary: User unable to access Fund X due to MFA failure
records.Description: User with the username 'user123' from the 'Manager' group is unable to log in to the Fund X platform using SSO. The user receives the error message 'MFA verification failed'. The user has already attempted the MFA step using their authenticator app, but the verification did not pass. The user is a manager for the 'Luxembourg' office and needs immediate access to Fund X for a meeting at 14:00 CET.

sofia.lind@intcom.com: Will escalate to the next level of support if the issue is not resolved within 30 minutes.

records.Summary: Request for additional storage licenses for the Identity & Access Management system
records.Description: The Zurich office reported that multiple teams are experiencing difficulties uploading new contracts due to insufficient storage space. The error message states: 'Insufficient storage space. Please contact support.' Despite the issue, the storage space is at 70% usage, far from the critical threshold. The teams have tried clearing temporary files and restarting their systems, but the issue persists. The activity affects internal and external teams handling contract uploads and document versioning.
All Comments: marc.dupont@intcom.com: CC: IT Support - Please verify the current storage usage and check for any misconfigurations that might be causing the issue.
marc.dupont@intcom.com: CC: Compliance - Ensure that this issue does not impact any regulatory compliance requirements for document storage.

records.Summary: Unable to upload new contract files in the document management system.
records.Description: Users in the Legal and Compliance departments are encountering an 'Access denied' error when trying to upload new contract files. The last successful upload was on 2023-10-05. The system shows that the user's role has the correct permissions. Users have tried clearing their browser cache and signing out/signing back in, but the issue persists. The upload limit for the document is 50MB, and the file size is within this limit. Error message: 'Access denied (code: 403)'.
All Comments: marc.dupont@intcom.com: IT Support: The issue seems to be related to a recent update to the document management system. We are investigating the cause.

records.Summary: Front-office trading application is experiencing issues with logins and blotter functionality. Users report slow screen,
records.Description: Since 10:30 AM, multiple users across different offices in Switzerland and France are reporting difficulties logging into the front-office trading application. Some users are seeing error messages like 'Session Timeout' and 'System Unavailable'. The application is also very slow, making it hard to access blotter and execute trades. We have tried restarting the application and clearing browser cache, but the issue persists. Affected users include portfolio managers and traders in both local and remote offices.
All Comments: eva.keller@intcom.com: Can someone check if there are any network issues affecting the front-office trading application?
sofia.lind@intcom.com: Let's escalate this to the senior support team as it's impacting multiple users and causing delays in trading activities.

records.Summary: Error encountered during fund reconciliation process
records.Description: During a routine bank reconciliation for the Luxembourg fund account, the system encountered an error message stating 'Insufficient funds for sweep operation'. The cash sweep for fund [XXLUX-001] was unsuccessful, and the liquidity management process was halted. The system did not allow the transaction to proceed, and the error message was logged at 14:30 CET. Steps taken included checking the available balance and re-entering the transaction, but the issue persists. This has affected the daily reconciliation of the Luxembourg fund account, which is critical for the upcoming fund reporting.
All Comments: eva.keller@intcom.com: Colleague: Have you verified the fund balance with the bank to ensure the issue isn't due to discrepancies in the bank statement?
jonas.berg@intcom.com: Colleague: It might also be worth checking if there's a pending approval for this transaction in the workflow system.

records.Summary: Order capture, routing and execution issues preventing order routing and execution for multiple funds
records.Description: Several orders are stuck in the system during the routing and execution phase. The error message states 'Broker routing table mapping not found [ERR-123456]'. Despite checking the clearing-account mappings, no resolution has been found. All orders in the 'Luxembourg' region are affected, including funds LUX-001, LUX-002, and LUX-003. Approvals are pending in the system, causing delays in order execution.
All Comments: eva.keller@intcom.com: Other teams have reported similar issues but with different error codes. We need to coordinate a broader analysis.
marc.dupont@intcom.com: The finance team is already impacted as some transactions are delayed, but we are not yet aware of any regulatory concerns.

records.Description: An automated monitoring alert for the front-office trading application was triggered but cleared itself.
